# DatePicker { #anylumino.DatePicker }

```python
DatePicker(
    value=None,
    description='',
    disabled=False,
    min=None,
    max=None,
    step=None,
    continuous_update=True,
    width='',
)
```

Browser-native date picker control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type     | Description                                                     | Default   |
|-------------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `None` |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control. | `''` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |
| min | optional | Minimum date, time, or datetime value. | `None` |
| max | optional | Maximum date, time, or datetime value. | `None` |
| step | optional | Native input step value. | `None` |
| continuous_update | optional | Whether Python receives updates while the user edits the input. | `True` |
| width | optional | CSS width for the control. | `''` |
